thread:
Priya K: quick approval ask — Daniel in sales needs a pilot pricing exception for Cobalt Health. 6-week pilot, estimated avg 200k tokens/day, ask is 50% off hosted API list, pilot commit $20k/mo. they need Private evaluation later; likely to convert to Dedicated. this exceeds our 30% pilot cap. tagging @Marco @Li for deal-desk signoff.
Daniel (AE): adding context — Cobalt is a hospital network, security review already started, target conversion to Dedicated in Q3. Sales forecast: 60% convert prob, if converted expect $60k/mo ARR. They want the 50% to remove friction for procurement.
Marco (Finance): what’s the margin impact during pilot? rough unit cost for hosted tokens?
Daniel (AE): rough calc: infra egress + tokens ~ $0.02 per 1k tokens on our side -> at 200k tokens/day ~ $4/day cost, ~ $120/mo infra. main risk is opportunity cost if we give big discount and they churn. conversion value outweighs pilot cost if convert.
Hannah (Legal): heads-up — if we do >30% discount need amended T&Cs and clear termination/rollback language. also confirm data residency clause for Private eval.
Li (RevOps): can we structure as 40% upfront + retrospective credits on conversion to match 50% effective? that reduces upfront revenue hit and aligns incentives.
Priya K: Li's idea sounds good. propose: approve 40% now for pilot, include a 50% retro-credit applied if they sign Dedicated within 90 days post-pilot. legal to draft amendment. finance to approve provisional 40% now.
finance-bot: Policy reference: Pilot discount cap = 30% standard. Exceptions require Finance Dir + RevOps signoff and Legal approval. Submit deal-desk form: https://redwood.internal/deal-desk
Marco (Finance): provisional approval for 40% pilot discount, conditional on: 1) deal-desk form filled, 2) legal amendment with retro-credit clause, 3) RevOps sets the credit workflow. If all done, finance will sign final approval.
Daniel (AE): thanks. will file deal-desk now and loop Legal + RevOps. expected to have doc by EOD.
Hannah (Legal): will draft a short amendment template and assume data residency addendum. ping me the signed NDA.
Li (RevOps): I'll create the credit workflow and a tracking tag in SFDC. assigning ticket FIN-3481.
Priya K: perfect — marking this thread: provisional 40% approved. final signoff pending deal-desk + legal. :white_check_mark:
Daniel (AE): cheers everyone, will update thread when docs uploaded.
Li (RevOps): done — created FIN-3481 and added note: conditional 40% pilot / 50% retro-credit on Dedicated conversion. linking to thread.
Marco (Finance): thanks — moving to close once I see deal-desk link. 
Daniel (AE): deal-desk submitted: https://redwood.internal/deal-desk/requests/8234 — attaching forecast and customer note.
Priya K: received. leaving final check to Marco + Hannah.
